caveats: Backtest uses only data before the simulation date (in-sample, past performance).
Weights are rebalanced daily and ignore fees, taxes and trading costs.
Test starts 2015-01-02, the first day every fund in either portfolio has prices.
Sector weights are today's, not point-in-time: a known approximation.
